plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a scientist named Ning Li at the University of Alabama in Huntsville in the 1990s and 2000s, who he calls a really interesting case. Michels says she spun solid superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance when very cold, very fast, and said they gave off gravitons, the tiny particles some physicists think carry gravity, which shielded things from gravity. He links her to a company called Anti-gravity LLC, and tells it as a possible human attempt to copy the kind of flight people attribute to UFOs.
